CA.rationale: An explicit processing/origin entry (history_estimate/feedback_through) is given adjacent to the same referent's red coordinates, linking a processing condition to the content's presentation.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an organization/presentation (coordinate pattern and grid orientation), and a separate status/origin entry are explicitly present for the same candidate referent.

A.rationale: An explicit origin/processing condition (history_estimate, feedback_through) is provided adjacent to the same referent's content coordinates, linking processing condition to content access/presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored coordinate sets (red/blue) for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata (command_estimate, feedback_through) are listed separately from the content coordinates for the same referent, distinguishing content identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (coordinate sets, grid orientation) and gives explicit organized patterns for candidate referents.
